resolution.question: Will Nimbus Freight's bid team get the Valdoria postal-contract tender signed by both required directors and submitted before Friday's 12:00 deadline?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the tender was signed by both required directors and submitted before 2026-08-28T12:00:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
